name: Kong Taoluo
source:
"Kong Taoluo died in Macao. It is a demon that draws this blade now. A demon... of vengeance!"

A master swordsman and Neijia practitioner; Kong Taoluo was once the top assassin in the Shanghai-based crime syndicate known as the "Qingyun Society." Renowned in the Chinese underworld as the "Lightning Palm," a moniker attributed to his Neijia based ability to channel internal energy and kill cyber-warriors with a single touch of his palm. He is one of the few unaugmented people left in the underworld; loathed by Waijia practitioners.

Betrayed, cut down and assumed dead by his childhood friend, fellow Society member and former Neijia master, [url=/c7183]Liu Haojun[/url]; Taoluo spends a year in hiding, recovering from his near-fatal injuries. Upon returning to Shanghai, he discovers the horrible truth of what has happened to his sister, [url=/c7182]Kong Ruili[/url]. He swears an oath of vengeance and sets out to murder those responsible, and to recover Ruili's soul fragments.
